label: Two-bedroom rent
note: Planning midpoint between published Millburn averages of $2,900 and $3,906.

label: Daycare · younger child
note: Rounded Essex County one-child estimate of $17,171/year. Actual full-day tuition varies by age and provider.

label: After-school care & camp
note: One child now. Annualized estimate using 36 weeks × $147 for aftercare, six weeks × $400 for camp, and $75 registration. Camp is a planning allowance.

label: Groceries
note: Essex County basic-needs food estimate for two adults and two children, $14,875/year.

label: Utilities, internet & phones
note: County internet and mobile benchmark of about $173, plus about $150 assumed for utilities. Check what rent includes.

label: Restaurants & takeout
note: Rounded from the U.S. household average of $329/month for food away from home.

label: One car, all-in
note: Planning estimate: $150 insurance plus $350 for fuel, maintenance and payment or replacement savings.

label: Commuter train, subway & parking
note: Published Millburn–New York Penn monthly train pass for one adult. Increase for subway or parking.

label: Healthcare
note: County family estimate of $11,353/year, including worker premiums and out-of-pocket costs.

label: Household & miscellaneous
note: Illustrative household allowance. Use for supplies, personal care and other recurring costs.
